image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cluster of ripe figs in a rustic container. The figs vary in color from deep purple-red to yellow-green. Several figs are split open or partially peeled, revealing the pinkish-red interior flesh and seeds. One fig in the foreground has a prominent stem attached. The lighting is bright, creating glossy highlights on the skin of the yellow figs.
